name: What is the role of a project manager in a home remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: What is the role of a project manager in a home remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A project manager's role in home remodeling is to oversee every aspect of the project, ensuring it stays on schedule, within budget, and meets quality standards. They are responsible for coordinating all tradespeople, ordering materials, managing permits, and communicating progress and any issues to the homeowner. For instance, Frasheski Construction's project managers act as your primary point of contact, streamlining communication and handling daily operational challenges. This oversight is crucial for maintaining efficiency and minimizing disruptions, ultimately delivering a seamless remodeling experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: A project manager oversees schedules, budgets, quality, and communication, coordinating trades and materials to ensure a smooth remodeling process.
